reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
reserveReview.rationale: Anzen states that each USDz is backed 1:1 by SPCT and identifies SPCT as the permissioned on-chain representation of its U.S. private-credit ABS portfolio. Public-RPC totalSupply reads on 2026-07-20 returned SPCT pool (0xf30a29f1c540724fd8c5c4be1af604a6c6800d29) totalSupply 8,225,104.2033 against aggregate USDz totalSupply of 8,120,206.6146 across Ethereum (811,082.23), Base (6,690,509.36), Arbitrum (77,436.72), Blast (41,012.52), and Manta (500,165.78), both figures unchanged from the 2026-07-14 readings, keeping SPCT coverage near 101.3% of USDz supply and confirming the single-asset reserve path without any USTB or other dependency. The 100% SPCT slice is unchanged; underlying loan-level weights are not published beyond Anzen's documented criteria (U.S.-based assets, ABS-only structures, single-asset concentration limits). Liquidity horizon is marked over-seven-days because SPCT is permissioned (KYC/KYB whitelist) and represents private credit, so reserve-level liquidation runs at loan/redemption timelines rather than public-market ones.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Anzen issuer disclosure corroborated by SPCT and multichain USDz totalSupply reads (public RPC, 2026-07-20)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: SPCT is fully identified as the direct reserve asset; its underlying private-credit loan-level weights are not a tracked-stablecoin dependency question and are not published by the issuer.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Anzen's RWA Partner page names Percent for underwriting and custody. No custody allocation, account segregation terms, trustee identity, or complete off-chain custody chain for the private-credit ABS notes is disclosed in the pages reviewed on 2026-10-01. The existing 100% protocol-contract row describes the direct on-chain SPCT reserve, not a measured allocation to Percent. Anzen's collateral documentation expressly states that disclosure does not create a claim for USDz holders to collateral assets; the adverse bankruptcy-remoteness disposition is retained. Rehypothecation and loan-level weights remain unknown. The issuer-linked rwa.anzen.finance transparency host could not be fetched this session, so no dashboard freshness or loan-level composition was established.
